# MBROLA Runtime

This directory contains the vendored MBROLA runtime pieces required to build and package the Windows SAPI5 and NVDA variants without depending on a separate local Festival installation.

Included here:

- `windows-x64/mbrola.exe`
- `voices/pl1`

The Android runtime continues to use its own bundled native executables in `android/app/src/main/jniLibs/`.
